tenderSchedule.description: CONSTRUCTION OF 11KV LINE UNDER SYSTEM IMPROVEMENT WORKS ON PARTIAL TURNKEY (RABBIT ACSR CONDUCTOR SUPPLIED BY BESCOM) UNDER PERCENTAGE QUOTING BASIS FOR OVER LOADED FEEDEERS

tenderAddress.blockNumber: Office of the Superintending Engineer, Ele,O and M Circle, Hadadi Road, BESCOM, Davangere-577004

generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidder shall abide all terms and conditions of bid documents

technicalCriterionList.description: 2.The bidder should have satisfactorily completed works involving 11 kV lines (OH/UG) or LT lines (OH/UG) either on Total Turnkey (TTK) basis or Partial urnkey (PTK) basis or through self-execution for any DISCOMs/ Govt. Departments including Public sector undertakings (PSUs) during the last Five Financial Years (FY 2021-22 to 2025-26) as on the date of Bid Submission. The value of such completed works shall not be less than 50% of the Amount Put to Tender greater than or equal to Rs. 10,43,116/- Note: 1 The value of the completed works shall be given a weight of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the FY in which the tenders are invited FY 2026-27.2 Work carried out under sub-contract will not be considered. 3.For the assessment, the date of completion will be considered. 4.SelfExecution means the work(s) executed on behalf of the consumer/applicant by an authorized contractor under the supervision of the DISCOMs/Govt. departments including PSUs.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- As per clause 3 of ITT

technicalCriterionList.description: 1.The Bidder should be in existence as any of the following a)Company incorporated in India under the Companies Act, 1956/2013 including any amendment thereto b) LLP incorporated in India under the Limited Liability Partnership (LLP) Act, 2008 including any amendment thereto c) Partnership Firm under Partnership Act, 1932 in India d) Sole Proprietorship concern

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- As per clause 3 of ITT

technicalCriterionList.description: 6.Any Bidder from a country which shares a land with India, will be eligible to bid in this tender only if the Bidder is registered with the Competent Authority.As per Government Order No. FD 455 Exp12 2020 dated 25.08.2020. A certificate for having read the clauses is required to be submitted uploaded by the Bidder separately in the following format. I have read the clause regarding restrictions on procurement from a Bidder of a country which shares a land border with India. I certify that this Bidder is not from such a country or if from such a country, has been registered with the Competent Authority. I hereby certify that this Bidder fulfills all requirements in this regard and is eligible to be considered. Where applicable, evidence of valid registration by the Competent Authority shall be attached.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- As per clause 3 of ITT

technicalCriterionList.description: 4.Bidders who meet the above-specified minimum qualifying criteria, will only be qualified, if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value.The available tender capacity will be calculated as under Assessed available tender capacity (AxNx2.5minusB) greater than Rs. 20,86,232.00 here A means Maximum value of works executed in any one year during the last five years from FY 2021-22 to FY 2025-26) (updated to FY 2026-27 price level) taking into account the completed as well as works in progress. N means Number of years prescribed for completion of the works for which tenders are invited. N equal to 1.B means Value, at FY-2026-27 price level, of existing commitments and on-going works to be completed during the next 1 year

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- As per clause 3 of ITT

technicalCriterionList.description: 3.The bidder should have achieved in at least TWO financial years during at least five years (i.e., FY 2021-22 to FY 2025-26). A minimum financial turnover of greater than or equal to Rs. 20,86,232.00/- (Usually not less than the amount put to tender) Note: The financial turnover shall be given a weight of 10% per year to bring them to the price level to FY 2026-27

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- As per clause 3 of ITT

technicalCriterionList.description: 8.In order to ensure the quality, performance, and compliance in accordance with applicable IS standards, the bidder shall source Poles only from manufacturer(s) who meet the following requirements i.The identified manufacturer(s) must be a valid approved vendor of BESCOM for supply of Poles. If not approved, the manufacturer(s) must obtain vendor approval from BESCOM prior to the opening of the price bid, failing which the bid will be liable for rejection. ii.The identified manufacturer(s) must have supplied Poles against Purchase Order(s) of any ESCOMs/ Govt. departments including Public sector undertakings (PSUs) in any one of the last five years (FY 2021-22 to FY 2025-26) as on the date of bid submission. Note At the time of execution, if the successful bidder intends to source Poles from a manufacturer other than the manufacturer(s) identified at the time of bid submission, prior approval of SE(Ele), BESCOM, O and M Circle, Davanagere shall be obtained, subject to fulfillment of the above two clauses.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- As per clause 3 of ITT

technicalCriterionList.description: 7.If the bidder participates in more than One Tender Enquiry under the Notification Inviting Tender (NIT) issued by the particular tender inviting authority for the work of extension of CONSTRUCTION OF 11KV LINE UNDER SYSTEM IMPROVEMENT WORKS ON PARTIAL TURNKEY BASIS (RABBIT ACSR CONDUCTOR SUPPLIED BY BESCOM), the bidder must demonstrate the aggregate of the Technical and Financial qualifying criteria of all the tender enquiries participated in. Note: If this condition is not met, the offer of the bidder will be considered to the tender enquiries in the descending order of contract value starting with the highest amount put to tender for which the bidder is eligible.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- As per clause 3 of ITT

technicalCriterionList.description: 5.Even though the Bidders meet the above criteria they are subject to be disqualified if they have i)made misleading or false representations in the forms statements and attachments submitted in proof of the qualification requirements and/or ii) record of poor performance such as abandoning the works, not properly completing the contract, inordinate delays incompletion, litigation history, or financial failures And/or iii)Participated in the previous Tender for the same work and had quoted unreasonably high tender prices and could not furnish rational justification. And/or iv)Blacklisted due to non performance in execution of works by any DISCOMs/ Public sector undertakings (PSUs)/Govt. departments as on date of bid submission. And/or v)Defaulted/short closed due to non performance in execution of works against the order placed by any DISCOMs/ Public sector undertakings (PSUs)/Govt. departments as on date of bid submission. vi)The information with regard to the assessment of the available tender capacity furnished is correct

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- As per clause 3 of ITT
